name: Multi-Tab Browser Context Switch Race
description: Switching to popup window without waiting for popup page event or DOMContentLoaded.

failure_vector.error_log: IndexOutOfBoundsException: Index 1 out of bounds for context.pages() size 1

expected_resolution.healed_code: def newPage = context.waitForPage { page.click('#open-window') }; newPage.waitForSelector('#confirm'); newPage.click('#confirm')
